call_of_abraham.title: God Calls Abraham
call_of_abraham.description: God calls Abraham and begins the covenant family.
call_of_abraham.storyNote: God calls Abram — the covenant family leaves Ur toward the land God will show.

abrahamic_covenant.storyNote: God’s covenant promises are sealed with Abraham.

birth_of_isaac.storyNote: The child of promise is born to Abraham and Sarah.

birth_of_jesus.title: Birth of Jesus
birth_of_jesus.description: Jesus is born in Bethlehem as the promised Son of David.
birth_of_jesus.storyNote: The Messiah is born — the line from Abraham to David finds its goal in Jesus.

burning_bush.title: Moses and the Burning Bush
burning_bush.description: God calls Moses from the line of Levi to deliver Israel.
burning_bush.storyNote: God calls Moses — priestly and prophetic leadership for Israel begins.

golden_calf_tabernacle.storyNote: Israel worships at the tabernacle; Aaron’s priestly line matters for access to God.

ten_commandments.storyNote: Covenant law is given at Sinai.

jacob_becomes_israel.storyNote: Jacob becomes Israel — father of the twelve tribes.

david_king_jerusalem.storyNote: David reigns in Jerusalem — toward the Messianic king.

davidic_covenant.storyNote: God promises an everlasting kingdom through David’s line.

crucifixion_resurrection.storyNote: Jesus dies and rises — the climax of the Messianic line.

john_baptist_prepares_way.storyNote: The forerunner points to the Messiah.

baptism_temptation_jesus.storyNote: Jesus is revealed and tested as Son of God.

sermon_on_mount.storyNote: Jesus teaches as the authoritative prophet-king.

noahs_ark.storyNote: Through Noah’s family the world is preserved toward Shem’s line.

tower_of_babel.storyNote: Nations scatter; later Terah’s line leads toward Abraham.

creation.storyNote: Humanity begins — every storyline flows from Adam.

fall_of_man.storyNote: Sin enters; the promise of redemption will run through a family line.
